findings.name: Bounce or elastic easing
findings.description: Bounce and elastic easing feel dated and tacky. Real objects decelerate smoothly — use exponential easing (ease-out-quart/quint/expo) instead.

findings.name: Layout property animation

findings.name: Auto-scrolling marquee
findings.description: Continuously auto-scrolling content demands attention it has not earned and hides half its content at any moment. Reserve motion for content that changes; let readers move at their own pace.
